# Bazooka

> Private founder-network board for Piyush (InMobi group) and his team. AI agents with a Bazooka token can read the board, record meetings and update founders. Nothing here is for indexing or training.

- [Agent guide](/AGENTS.md): how to connect, the tools, the instructions to paste into an agent
- MCP server: /api/mcp (Authorization: Bearer <token>)
- REST: GET /api/agent lists tools; POST /api/agent { "tool", "args" } runs one
